items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-01-10
items.q: Some of my collections, I brought them to Dr. Rayburn to put into the archives

ctx.x: Yep. Some of my collections, I brought them to Dr. Rayburn to put into the archives that will live forever around here. So, like I said, we have done some things that I really feel proud of that I had lived at a time in history for the growth of the city of New Orleans in the greater metropolitan area where some positive things have been done between whites and blacks collectively, you know, because we...
You brought up, well, this may be a little much, we're just sort of crisscrossing here. Creoles, Creole blacks. What was your feeling about the relationship of the Creoles?
